summary: Full e2e test of the icon-account + admin-review feature on songcoder.html. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_mad_icon_review.py (icon-session verified vs unverified, PUT scope: main forbidden, non-ICON file forbidden, cross-artist block tampering forbidden, own-bio allowed; branch-ref scope: non-icon/other-icon prefixes forbidden; icon merge forbidden; /github/activity and /github/icon-admin forbidden; /pulls scoped to own icon/<id>/ only; admin approve merges into main; admin reject-with-note closes PR and persists '**Not approved:** <note>' in body; access-requests: unverified → 403 icon_unverified; icon-request persisted; approve grants icon session with chosen artistId; decline removes the request; revoke invalidates existing icon session). Frontend: all UI acceptance criteria met. (A) Icon sign-in: no sb-* token → clicking settings-treesh-signin-btn opens icon-signin-needed-modal; with mock-chelly → settings-auth-status reads 'Signed in as Chelly Banqz (Icon #11) until Nov 8, 2026…'. (B) Icon mode UI: only tabs Compose/Catalog/Artists visible (Projects/Models/Blog/What's New hidden); mode-seg hidden; open-review-btn hidden; new-artist-btn hidden; bulk-import-btn and reorder-btn not rendered; Settings Repository section not rendered; connection pill shows 'Chelly Banqz · Icon'. (C) Scope: Artists tab only renders artist-card-11 (artist-card-name is an inner element, not another card); Catalog renders only Chelly songs (11 songs, header 'Catalog 56' is total count across repo, UI filters). (D) Edit profile: hover artist-card-11 → artist-edit-btn visible → change bio TEST_BIO_FOR_REVIEW_ZZZ → save-button is 'Send for review' → publish-success-modal shows 'Sent for review\n#1 · Chelly Banqz: Update artist: Chelly Banqz\nTreesh admin will look it over…' with success-open-my-changes-btn. Backend state after: branches=['main','icon/11/artist-edit-chelly-banqz-…'], pulls=[(1,'icon/11/…','main','open')], /mockgh/raw/content/icons.html?branch=main does NOT contain the new bio. (E) My changes drawer: titled 'MY CHANGES', rows pr-row-1 'In review', no visible github.com links. (F) Admin review: passcode sign-in reveals open-review-btn with review-count badge '1'; drawer review-drawer opens; review-tab-changes lists review-pr-N cards; review-view-btn loads review-pr-diff with review-item cards (review-item, review-item-name, review-item-type). Approve: review-approve-btn → review-approve-modal → confirm-ok-btn → PR becomes merged, main icons.html contains APPROVE_MARKER_ZZZ. Reject-with-note: review-reject-btn → review-reject-modal → review-reject-note-input ('Please tighten to 2 sentences.') → review-reject-confirm-btn → PR#2 state=closed, merged_at=None, body contains the exact note. Icon re-signs in: open-prs-btn drawer shows pr-row-2 'Not approved' with pr-row-reject-note='Please tighten to 2 sentences.' alongside pr-row-1 'Approved'. (G) Access requests: fan (mock-fan, unverified) → icon-access-modal opens with icon-access-select (13 options starting 'Pick your Icon page' then alphabetical by name) and icon-access-note; selecting '3' (SAVIONCE) + note + 'Send request' → toast + persisted; re-attempting sign-in shows icon-access-pending. Admin review drawer → review-tab-access shows review-request-u-fan with select preselected to '3' (SAVIONCE), approve → fan session becomes 'Signed in as SAVIONCE (Icon #3)' (/github/session role=icon artistId=3). Revoke: review-revoke-btn → review-revoke-modal → Revoke → fan /github/session returns signedIn=false (session invalidated via ICONS[revoked]).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py icon_put_ok() correctly checks (a) path ∈ ICON_FILES, (b) branch starts with icon/<id>/, (c) scope_ok() diff only touches blocks the icon owns — including the lyrics-via-songs-title linkage for lyric blocks without data-artist-id. Mirrors netlify/functions/github.mjs iconGuard/scopeOk.

scope_ok() does whitespace-insensitive comparison of 'rest' between base and next to detect any out-of-block tampering, and compares the join of non-owned blocks character-exact — robust against reordering or insertion attacks.
list_pulls() filters per-icon by head.ref.startswith('icon/<artistId>/'); admin sees all. Verified both ways.
pull_merge() admin-only; pull_patch() admin-only — matches review spec (icon cannot approve or close/reopen).
Create ref (create_ref) enforces regex ^refs/heads/icon/<artistId>/[\w./-]+ for icons — tested both 'songcoder/x' and cross-icon 'icon/3/evil' are 403.

icon_session() returns 403 icon_unverified with 'requested' flag reflecting ICONS['requests']; admin icon-admin POST pops the request on any action (approve/revoke/decline), which is what the UI relies on for the Access list to update after Decline.
Session invalidation on revoke uses ICONS['revoked'][uid] > payload.exp - MAX_AGE*1000. Correct for existing sessions issued before revocation.
Icon admin GET returns requests sorted desc by timestamp; approved list is a plain list — fine for the current UI.
Minor: /github/icon-request has no rate-limiting; preview-only is acceptable.
No MongoDB in play; no ObjectId concerns. CORS allow_credentials=True + allow_origins from env (set to the preview origin by default).
Frontend icon helpers (isIcon/isAdmin/mine/applyRole) correctly hide tabs, mode toggles, open-review, bulk/new-artist/reorder, and the Repository block in Settings for role=icon.
Reject-note flow stores the note in the PR body as '**Not approved:** <note>' and the icon drawer's prRow(icon=true) renders pr-row-reject-note from PR#.body — tested round trip.

pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope which caused cross-class resets to race (reset() wipes shared ICONS/STATE). Our test file uses one Class per flow, and running with -n 0 is required for determinism. Noted in the test file; recommend adding a worker-serialising fixture or using a per-test unique state when shared global state is in play.
test_credentials: Admin passcode: TreeshMAD-test-2026 (in /app/backend/.env MAD_PASSCODE). Icon mock tokens via SUPA in /app/backend/server.py: mock-chelly (verified, artist #11), mock-fan (unverified), mock-savionce (unverified). Icon sign-in UI: localStorage.setItem('sb-mock-auth-token', JSON.stringify({access_token:'mock-chelly', expires_at: now+3600})) then Settings → settings-treesh-signin-btn.
seed_data_creation: Each scenario called POST /api/mockgh/reset to clear branches/pulls/ICONS. During frontend flow we created icon PRs #1 (approved via admin merge) and #2 (rejected-with-note); state is left reset-friendly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key testids used: open-settings-btn, settings-passcode-input, settings-signin-btn, settings-treesh-signin-btn, settings-auth-status, icon-signin-needed-modal, icon-access-modal/select/note/pending, tab-{compose,catalog,artists,projects,models,blog,whatsnew}, artist-card-<id>, artist-edit-btn, artist-bio-input, publish-success-modal, success-open-my-changes-btn, open-prs-btn, pr-row-<n>, pr-row-reject-note, open-review-btn, review-count, review-drawer, review-tab-{changes,access,recent}, review-pr-<n>, review-view-btn, review-pr-diff, review-item{,-name,-type}, review-approve-btn, review-approve-modal, confirm-ok-btn, review-reject-btn, review-reject-modal, review-reject-note-input, review-reject-confirm-btn, review-request-<uid>, review-request-{approve-btn,decline-btn,icon-select}, review-revoke-btn, review-revoke-modal. Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_mad_icon_review.py — RUN SERIALLY with `pytest -n 0` because pytest.ini is -n 2 --dist loadscope and reset() wipes shared ICONS/STATE across classes. Backend server loads mock_data/*.html at import; the preview-public /api/mockgh/raw endpoint is unauthenticated and great for verifying main after approve/reject. The Settings drawer's inner buttons sometimes report 'outside viewport' to Playwright even when visible; use `document.querySelector(sel).click()` via page.evaluate to bypass.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The implementation precisely matches the review spec on both server (iconGuard+scopeOk mirrored from netlify/functions/github.mjs) and client (role-gated UI, PR branches under icon/<id>/, reject-note round-trip).
